nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Alpine image for the opencode CLI: copies the prebuilt musl binaries (x64-baseline and arm64, selected by TARGETARCH) into a minimal runtime with libgcc, libstdc++, and ripgrep, disables the Bun transpiler cache for ephemeral containers, smoke-tests the binary, and sets opencode as the entrypoint. Built and pushed as ghcr.io/anomalyco/opencode by the release publish script.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses buildx's TARGETARCH ARG to select between per-architecture stages (build-amd64/build-arm64) so a single multi-platform build ships both musl binaries. BUN_RUNTIME_TRANSPILER_CACHE_PATH=0 avoids useless cache writes on ephemeral containers.

nodes.name: base
nodes.summary: Alpine base stage shared by both architecture stages: installs the libgcc, libstdc++, and ripgrep runtime dependencies and disables the Bun runtime transpiler cache.

nodes.name: build-amd64
nodes.summary: Architecture stage for linux/amd64 that copies the prebuilt x64-baseline musl opencode binary from dist into /usr/local/bin.

nodes.name: build-arm64
nodes.summary: Architecture stage for linux/arm64 that copies the prebuilt arm64 musl opencode binary from dist into /usr/local/bin.

nodes.name: build-${TARGETARCH}
nodes.summary: Final stage selected by buildx's TARGETARCH: resolves to build-amd64 or build-arm64, verifies the binary with opencode --version, and sets opencode as the container entrypoint.
